build.method: Original PlatformIO builder with verified upstream packages and local cloud overrides

validation.certificate_checks: RSA/ECC accepted; wrong hostname, expired, untrusted and tampered certificates rejected in native BearSSL tests
validation.clock_checks: 6 native groups: Wi-Fi startup, retry intervals, reconnect/manual retry, millis wraparound, browser epoch validation, HTTP Date validation
validation.pinned_tls: Real OpenSSL/BearSSL TLS 1.2 handshakes: matching RSA, P-256, P-384 and P-521 keys accepted without clock/CA despite expired self-signed certificates; different keys rejected
validation.pin_export: Verified TLS export succeeds; expired, untrusted and wrong-host certificates rejected
validation.request_stack: Compiled Xtensa prologues inspected: request 336 bytes, streamed parser core 448 plus 112-byte wrapper, dashboard state 576, render 320, appearance save 208, welcome 144, setup-page assembly 64 bytes; no framebuffer
validation.browser_flow: Request interception without HTTP server: 3 modes x 5 themes on desktop/mobile; all seven trend directions and unknown, low/high/old/no-clock/empty/error, custom contrast, authenticated CSRF mode-save payloads and rejected-session handling, safe name text, large-name width limits/ellipsis and offline retention; actual ESP8266 HTTP/EEPROM/SPI/OTA checks pending
validation.reading_history: 6 native groups updated for 30 minutes: freshness, 7-point sorted/bucketed history, plot boundaries and gaps, streamed 31-entry JSON with large ignored fields, invalid/empty readings, newest entry/trends
validation.web_assets: Checked-in gzip flash assets verified against HTML/CSS/JS sources
validation.external_api_smoke_test: Last live API check in v0.5.2: count=31 returned HTTP 200, 9492 bytes accepted by native body/JSON decoder with identity and re-framed chunked transport. TLS/clock/streaming decoding rules unchanged in v0.7.0; welcome progress hooks added, no glucose values retained
validation.http_body: 5 native groups: identity/content length, chunked framing/extensions/trailers, fragmented and short reads, truncation/trailing data, malformed chunks/body limits, raw-chunk regression and precise parser stages
validation.patient_name: Original 3732-byte settings layout and trust-key offset unchanged; tagged EEPROM name extension, erased storage rejection, bounded UTF-8 validation and Spanish display transliteration tested
validation.appearance: 3 native groups: tagged 20-byte extension at EEPROM offset 3836, old server/token/key/name preserved, erased storage defaults, partial mode updates, atomic rejection, presets/custom colors and contrast after RGB565 quantization
validation.startup: Native stage checks: Wi-Fi pending/connected, HTTP and network errors, rejected JSON, valid empty response, first valid reading, non-200 cannot finish startup, live view retained after later failures
validation.browser_setup: Actual C++ setup page renderer with host String/flash/send adaptations; request interception without HTTP server: mobile/desktop steps, UTF-8 SSID byte limit, Wi-Fi/URL/token/PEM/admin validation, hidden-details error focus, back/Enter without early POST, text-safe secret-free summary, CSRF payload, 400/401/403/500 and network failures retaining fields, duplicate-save guard, success clearing secrets, no-JavaScript fallback
validation.startup_layout: Representative longest labels, AP SSID/key/IP and footer checked against TFT_eSPI font 2 widths and 240x240 circular bounds; physical SPI output pending

setup.password: Generated on-device and shown on the display

tls_authentication.default: Public CA chain, hostname and certificate date validation; requires a valid clock
tls_authentication.optional: Explicit server public-key pin; TLS proof of key possession without CA chain/hostname/certificate date checks
tls_authentication.clock_bootstrap: Fresh HTTP Date after a successful pinned HTTPS request only; never from a glucose reading or unverified HTTP

interface.web_authentication: Existing administrator credentials; per-boot CSRF nonce required for POST /appearance
interface.assets: Five gzip PROGMEM resources plus flash setup-template fragments; no filesystem upload, framebuffer or external browser dependencies
interface.patient_name_storage: Tagged 104-byte EEPROM extension after the unchanged v3 settings; empty label uses NIGHTSCOUT
view_modes: centered large number with lower arrow
interface.patient_name_header: Named patient: TFT font 2 size 2 (32px) centered at y=43, width cap 120px; web 28px at baseline y=53, width cap 128px; ellipsis preserves large text and full stored name; empty-name fallback unchanged

startup.design: B: actual Wi-Fi, HTTP 200 and first-reading stages
startup.patient_name: same large font, centered at y=82, width cap 170px
startup.exit: first successfully decoded available reading; later errors keep live display

initial_setup.navigation: retains fields within current visit; no persistent browser storage
initial_setup.save: single final authenticated/CSRF-protected POST; encrypted setup AP with on-screen generated password before initial credentials exist
initial_setup.summary: network, patient and base URL only; no passwords, token or PEM contents
initial_setup.no_javascript: all three sections visible; original native form POST with CSRF

http_body.fallback: After full-history decode failure, poll latest-reading API every 30 seconds and retry full history after 5 minutes; keep old history and mark partial
